CPU_selection: Refresh affinity, per-affinity idle capacity, cgroup quotas, and concurrent allocations; use available slots with disjoint CPU groups.

memory_admission.required: estimate_per_process_bytes * process_slots <= fresh effective available RAM

quota_policy: No quota CLI exposed; future approval must select an explicitly accepted supported quota policy before a valid grant.
preparation_cache: Restore saved H6 context once per scope, fork reuse; no SCF/DF/state generation.
grant_policy: Two separate per-scope one-shot grants; drafts stay false, new approval receipt required. No automatic retry/next stage.
completion_requires: exact n and both axes for all registered tasks
K2 original law and event support; paired same trajectory
four control probes and independent oracle per scope
parent and task ledger exact nonrefundable budgets
native driver exit0 and wait4 reaped
all trajectory/control/axis descendants exit0 and reaped
raw result SHA and exact task set
